topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found the manuscript tucked away in the back of the wardrobe, tied with a frayed ribbon. Each page spoke my name, and the words wove a tapestry of our life together, seen through his eyes. It was both intimate and revealing, a story I never knew he was writing. I should have been flattered, but instead, I felt exposed, as if I had been watched without knowing. The room seemed smaller, the air thick. Maybe I should speak to him about it, understand why this secret garden of words sprouted between us.
